events.title: The first big update to the Origins demo just landed!
events.summary: This update brings a lot of new content and polish to our demo, such as:- Upgraded UI- New look of our game board- A collectors tutorial explaining the key aspects of collecting- Test packs to rip- New voicelines- Balance changesWe'll share the details on the balance changes soon!Next to todays update we will be turning on ranked mode with the start of Steam Next Fest, which will come with exclusive ranked rewards!This update also brings the (tentative) card list for our Crimson Cup in October.

events.title: Hello From The Origins TCG Team
events.summary: Hey everyone and welcome to our very first Steam post. If you're reading this, you somehow found your way to Origins TCG, and that already means a lot to us. We've been building this game for a while now, and getting our Steam page live feels like a real moment.Origins is a trading card game built around fast tactical matches and a collectible card system much like you would see in physical trading cards.
